description: Return nodes whose child count (children via parent edges; mesh cross-links don't count) is ≥ minConnections, grouped by type; use for /restructure hub detection. Each row includes `same_typed_child_count` - the number of children of the SAME type as the node (the Naumu hub-pattern signal) and `connection_count` - its total children. Sort the response by `same_typed_child_count` descending and route any node with ≥10 same-typed children through a mini-hub split. Pass `nodeTypes` (comma-separated) to restrict to a subset (e.g. ["Type A","Type B"]). Cheap to call - runs a single Cypher aggregation.

minConnections.description: Minimum number of children (parent edges; mesh cross-links excluded). Typical: 10 for hub detection, 11 to count only hubs that exceed the round-4 ≤10 threshold.

nodeTypes.description: Optional list of node types to restrict the scan to.

name: naumu_list_dense_nodes
title: List Dense Nodes
